title: 8 GB graphics cards
evidence: O23: Qwen3.5 2B, bf16 LoRA at 16K, measured on an RTX 5070 Laptop (8,151 MiB) in L0d and L2b: 7,580-7,700 MiB reserved under the 95% cap, so with the CUDA context it fills the 8 GB card (its need, 8,192 MiB, is the whole card: it starts when no more than 160 MiB is in use); about 41 minutes per epoch of 360 conversations. L2x, measured on an RTX 5090 under an 8 GB cap: 90 rows in 23 steps at 2.5 s/step with a pause and resume, 8,006 MiB on the card at its peak, 13.8 GB of the computer's commit (Windows) at its peak (need 15 GB with a 1 GB margin), gradient norms 0.3-1.0, loss 0.46, no spill; exported Q8_0 and ready in Row-Bot's own server.
